title: How to use the e-book reader
description: Try turning pages, jumping to chapters, changing the reading display and saving your place in this short practice edition.

chapters.title: Turn a page
paragraphs: You're in the Acuity e-book reader. Tap or click the arrow at the right edge to go forward. The arrow at the left edge takes you back.
On a keyboard, try the Right Arrow key. In the standard view you can also use Next and Previous at the bottom of the page.
Turn forward now to practise jumping between chapters.

chapters.title: Jump to a chapter
paragraphs: Open Contents using the list icon in the top bar. Choose “Make the page your own” to jump there directly.
Try returning to “Turn a page” the same way, then choose “Make the page your own” again to continue.

chapters.title: Make the page your own
paragraphs: Open Settings using the gear icon. Choose a different text font, increase the text size and try the Warm page colour. Close Settings to see how this page reads.
Try Fullscreen using the expand icon. The compact top bar keeps Contents and Settings within reach. Use the same icon to return to the standard view.
When you're ready, turn forward or choose “Save your place” in Contents.

chapters.title: Save your place
paragraphs: In Settings, tick “Remember my place on this device”. Close the reader, then open this guide again in the same browser. It should reopen at your saved passage.
To start fresh next time, untick the option. To save an entire Library entry for later, use its bookmark button and open Reading list in the catalogue.
